title: Unit – 1 : Session – 7 : SLO – 1  |  File and Device Management — Word Puzzle
sections: I. Words Found in the Puzzle
BUFFERING — storing data temporarily while it is transferred between devices.
CACHING — keeping copies of frequently used data in faster storage.
DMA — Direct Memory Access; lets devices transfer data without CPU involvement.
DEVICE MANAGEMENT — OS component controlling I/O devices via drivers.
FILE MANAGEMENT — creating, deleting, organizing files and directories.
KERNEL — core of the OS coordinating all these services.
SPOOLING — Simultaneous Peripheral Operations On-Line; queuing jobs for devices like printers.
USER — the entity on whose behalf these services run.
File management: file creation/deletion, directory structure, access control, free-space tracking.
Device management: device drivers, buffering, caching, spooling, DMA-based transfers,
and a uniform I/O interface for applications.
